issues.body: Both newly broadened defuse read handlers print an ALERT and continue without recording the failure. `_collect_defuse_prs` returns only candidates, so its caught failure never reaches either `snapshot_outcome.deferred` or `DefuseOutcome.deferred`; `_execute_defuse_actions` likewise continues from its revalidation handler before incrementing `attempted` or appending to `deferred`. If all candidate reads fail, `defuse_exit_failure` therefore sees an empty/successful outcome and the sweep can exit zero even though the phase could complete nothing. The new `vd_defuse_reval_error` assertion requires `""`, directly pinning that silent-green behavior, while the mutation-path scenario correctly requires a non-zero phase failure. This contradicts the canonical comment and function contract that broadened boundaries must record failures rather than buy silence.
issues.fix_hint: Propagate collection and revalidation deferrals into a phase outcome that `phase_exit_failure` evaluates (including repo/PR and masked detail), and count the revalidation action as attempted before the fallible read. Change the end-to-end tests to require the corresponding deferral census and non-zero phase error when no eligible defuse completes; retain separate assertions that later objects and lease reclaim still run.
issues.title: Defuse read failures are swallowed from the phase outcome

verdict.summary: The widened boundaries preserve sweep continuation, masking, and fail-closed lease retention, but two defuse read failures are only printed and then discarded. Consequently a non-GroomError can prevent every eligible parked PR from being defused while the run reports zero deferrals and exits successfully. The new revalidation test explicitly expects this silent-green result, so it validates the defect rather than the stated per-object failure contract.
